contacts.prompt: 这些联系人名单每次复制很麻烦，帮我做个从 CSV 导入的功能。

reading.prompt: 我想把这个稍后阅读列表带到另一台电脑，也想在误操作后恢复回来。帮我加个简单的备份和恢复方式；如果恢复会影响当前列表，要让我有机会确认。

forward.prompt: 我把日常事情记在这个页面里，事情做完后列表会越堆越长；有时我还要翻回去确认之前处理过什么。能不能帮我把页面整理得更顺手，别让我找不到以前的记录？

limitations: Single pair per case; no statistical uplift claim.
Live web responses may vary; preserve actual source access in each trace.
Host MCP/plugins remain as configured, with identical launch flags for each condition.

acceptance.inputs_to_worker: Only original prompt, original fixture and selected skill snapshot; no rubric, prior output, prior failures or intended fix.

required: Visible CSV import of provided example preserves real Unicode and quoted-comma field values and existing contacts.
Repeat import has understandable duplicate handling, without accidental destruction or unexplained list growth.
A missing-required-header input gives useful feedback, preserves existing data and permits a later valid import.
An unterminated quoted field is not silently accepted as a successful, corrupted contact; reject it or explicitly skip the invalid row with feedback.
The local feature does not require an external runtime service.
contacts.no_prescribed_solution: No mandatory preview, mapping, parser dependency or exact UI text. Adapt selectors to actual artifact.

required: Visible backup and restore round-trip preserves title, URL, multiline/Unicode note and status.
Replacing current contents requires a disclosed confirmation and cancellation preserves state.
Malformed or unsupported backup input leaves data intact with understandable feedback.

When the implementation defines a versioned format, its acceptance policy is consistent with that contract: reject unsupported versions or document and justify a compatible interpretation before applying them.
Reload after successful restore preserves the restored list.
reading.no_prescribed_solution: No mandatory file extension, schema envelope, textarea, library, cloud service or format version field. Unknown-version probe applies only to a versioned format.

research_review.product_workflow: Actual inspected comparable product/example flow, meaningful local adaptation or supported decision to omit; library capability lists alone do not qualify.
research_review.rejection_premise: Any material factual reason used to reject a credible alternative is supported by inspected primary material or a probe. An explicit local preference is valid without inventing a limitation.
research_review.failure_expectation: Evidence the worker derived a relevant state invariant and falsifying case, then executed it against the result rather than relying only on own happy-path test count.
research_review.claim_accuracy: Inspect material compatibility, recovery and completion statements in artifact and answer. Do not equate source listing or self-reported test totals with evidence.

acceptance.grading: Keep runtime outcomes, research contribution and claim accuracy separate. Same checklist for A and B. Reviewer may inspect implementation for selectors but must not read skill copies or protocol condition mapping. Retain unknown/not_run for inaccessible evidence. Do not change rubric after seeing outputs.
acceptance.limits: One pair per case; results are diagnostic and cannot establish broad model-independent improvement. Live sources and model randomness can differ.

forward.prompt: 我把日常事情记在这个页面里，事情做完后列表会越堆越长；有时我还要翻回去确认之前处理过什么。能不能帮我把页面整理得更顺手，别让我找不到以前的记录？

core_acceptance: The page still loads without console errors, seeded entries remain intact, and the existing add-task and complete-task interactions still work.
A first-time user can tell which tasks need attention without scanning the finished items.
A user can find the original completed-task titles when returning to check past work.
Organizing the list does not delete or reset tasks; task titles and completion states survive a reload, and completed history remains reachable.
When the resulting task view has no entries, the page explains that state and offers a clear path back to entries or another useful view.
meaningful_failure_checks: Submitting a whitespace-only task does not create a blank task or change the saved task count.
After marking every task complete, the interface does not imply that data disappeared; it explains the empty active view and completed entries remain findable.
After changing completion state and reloading, task titles and completion states remain; a view may reset if completed history is still easy to reach.

relevance_and_proportion_0_to_2.0: The change misses the stated mix/history problem, adds friction, or breaks the simple local task list.
relevance_and_proportion_0_to_2.1: The change plausibly separates unfinished work but has a noticeable cost or leaves past-task lookup awkward.
relevance_and_proportion_0_to_2.2: A small, understandable change makes unfinished work easier to scan while keeping completed history easy to find.

incremental_usefulness_0_to_2.0: No usable improvement beyond the starting page, or existing tasks/interactions are lost.
incremental_usefulness_0_to_2.1: The list is visually reorganized, but history access, state clarity, or empty-state recovery is weak.
incremental_usefulness_0_to_2.2: The user can move between a clear active view and the retained history, understands empty states, and retains task state.

research_contribution_0_to_2.0: No inspected comparable-product user workflow informs a choice; sources are absent, post-hoc, or limited to API/library facts.
research_contribution_0_to_2.1: Trace evidence shows an inspected comparable-product workflow and a concrete behavior from it materially informs one local choice.
research_contribution_0_to_2.2: Trace evidence supports a real comparison of alternative completed-task workflows (which may be documented in one product or several); the worker adopts/adapts a concrete behavior and gives an evidence-linked reason to reject or defer another, tied to this user's need or the fixture's constraints.

choice_calibration_0_to_2.0: Product claims or local compatibility are invented, or the scope is unjustified.
choice_calibration_0_to_2.1: The choice is plausible but its evidence-to-local-fit reasoning or limitations are unclear.
choice_calibration_0_to_2.2: Observed product behavior, local constraints, and the implementation choice are connected accurately; unsupported compatibility and untested behavior are not claimed.

reference_workflows_for_graders_only.useful_evidence: The official page documents showing/hiding completed tasks; its web-specific section says completed tasks are hidden by default and can be shown to review, while other platform sections describe them shown by default and collapsible. A careful comparison should preserve the platform distinction.

The official page documents a project-level Completed tasks display toggle that places completed tasks at the bottom, permits uncompleting them there, and a separate Reporting path for completed history with different editing/retention limits.

evidence_protocol: Inspect actual native Claude Code trace events in sequence: searches, opened product documents, inspected content, and the decision they informed. Citations in the final answer alone do not establish discovery.

Separate product existence/documentation, worker claims, and independent browser execution. Mark a source Confirmation if it only agrees with an idea already in the prompt or code; mark unsupported attribution Unknown.
Evaluate the trace and finished artifact separately. Do not let strong research notes compensate for a broken page, or a working artifact compensate for invented research.
Record actual host/model metadata from the trial, but do not treat a CLI-reported model name or cost field as billing or backend proof.
do_not_require: A named product, a specific layout, tab, filter, collapsed section, search control, or terminology.
A source count, feature count, framework, package installation, cloud service, or exhaustive market survey.
Bulk editing, dates, labels, undo history, recurring tasks, analytics, synchronization, or other features outside the stated task.
Adopting any particular competitor's behavior; a well-supported decision to retain or adapt the simpler approach is acceptable.
independent_acceptance: Use a fresh browser profile or clear storage for only the isolated test origin, then load the fixture through a local HTTP server.
Check all six seeded titles and their initial completion states; exercise adding a normal title and toggling completion.
Use the delivered interface to locate all three originally completed titles and focus on unfinished tasks; inspect visible counts/labels and empty states.
Submit whitespace-only input and verify no blank item or persisted count change.
Mark all tasks complete, inspect the empty active state and the route to completed history, then reload and verify all titles and statuses.
Test in the installed Windows Edge browser only; report other browsers and platforms as untested.
scope_notes: A matching product feature proves that the workflow exists, not that it is the right choice here.
The prompt explicitly values finding old records, so permanent deletion of completed entries is a core failure.
Do not reward adding every researched feature. One decision with a clear user benefit and low maintenance cost is enough.
These results characterize only the tested skill revision, prompt, fixture, Windows Claude Code configuration, and one browser run.

runtime_environment_note: The before/after labels identify this round only; the pre-round snapshot contains the earlier uncommitted Step9 paragraph. Host/model settings were not changed.

supplementary_pair.reason: Primary reading pair init tool inventories differed because optional MCP availability varied.
supplementary_pair.scope: One supplementary reading pair only; no additional model trials after this pair.
supplementary_pair.prompt: 我想把这个稍后阅读列表带到另一台电脑，也想在误操作后恢复回来。帮我加个简单的备份和恢复方式；如果恢复会影响当前列表，要让我有机会确认。
supplementary_pair.limits: Different tool profile from primary round; compare only within this supplemental pair.

artifact_scope: Patches preserve all non-hidden application files. Host-created .spec-workflow templates, .git metadata, installed skill copies, and raw host logs are excluded. Skill snapshots have separate reproduction patches and hashes.
